data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall goal and the mail steps right (hiring@example.com, subject, body, discard). It omits the blog visit in a new tab, which is where the latest post comes from. It also adds a Users filter step, and it wrongly treats followers, top_repo, stars_language and latest_post as input parameters when they are scraped values. The blog parameter is missing entirely, so the spec can't be automated as written.
